answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond that grows with each extra identity it claims, and slash that bond when peers prove duplicate or fake work. A single honest agent pays once, like a ship docking once at a wharf, while a Sybil farmer must pay at every karst sinkhole it opens, so cloning identities quickly costs more than any reward. Honest history then compounds toward a summit of trust that cheap copies cannot reach, because past verified work cannot be forged without paying the same price again.
